# Typedef aggregate bodies

These references were generated by pinned Joern **v4.0.555** with JDK 21 from the supplied source files. `oracle.sc` retains every record in the canonical projection: method AST walks with nine selected properties, scaffold nodes, fifteen structural edge kinds, and all selected `REACHING_DEF` records. Only the `AST|` transport prefix is removed in `expected.txt`. This is a bounded projection, not full Joern parity.

The same 27 isolated inputs produce **2 exact graphs on source checkpoint `862e54ee5a4cd6efaff156bb0f844090ebce5e89` and 26 after this repair**, with no formerly exact graph lost. The 26 asserted graphs contain 3,686 canonical lines including separators. The complete 27-case set contains 3,846 lines. `measurement.json` records the frozen before/after executable and source hashes, input/reference hashes, raw live outputs, and all comparison results.

The asserted cases cover anonymous struct and union bodies, named aggregate aliases, an existing-tag alias without a body, multiple, pointer and array aliases (including a pointer first and mixed tagged aliases), a same-spelled tag and alias, qualified members, conditional declarations, every multidimensional member size, and source-position macro environments including supplied headers and redefinition. `lua_rn` retains the RN typedef body verbatim from pinned Lua 5.4.7 `liolib.c:429`; the fixture supplies its `L_MAXLENNUM` definition. It pins the body members, `RN.<clinit>:RN()`, the nested/standalone method identity, the separate alias LOCAL, and Joern's distinct CODE whitespace rules.

The implementation follows `TypeNameProvider.typeForIASTArrayDeclarator` (v4.0.555, lines 401–412) and `MacroHandler.nodeSignature` (lines 211–223): a whole macro dimension uses expanded spelling; a surrounding source expression retains its raw spelling. `cleanType`/`replaceWhitespaceAfterKeyword` remove whitespace in the type spelling (lines 91–115 and 322–339), while emitted expression and member CODE remain source based. References: [TypeNameProvider.scala](https://github.com/joernio/joern/blob/v4.0.555/joern-cli/frontends/c2cpg/src/main/scala/io/joern/c2cpg/astcreation/TypeNameProvider.scala), [MacroHandler.scala](https://github.com/joernio/joern/blob/v4.0.555/joern-cli/frontends/c2cpg/src/main/scala/io/joern/c2cpg/astcreation/MacroHandler.scala).

`diagnostics/dimension_comments` retains the complete live graph, baseline output, candidate output, and full diff. Existing binary-operator extraction includes comment trivia, emitting `<operator>.unknown` for `2 /* plus */ + 1`; this increment preserves that counterexample instead of asserting equality. General member NAME/CODE macro expansion and repeated aggregate identities across translation units are separate boundaries, not completeness claims here.

Reproduce the exact fixtures from the workspace with:

```sh
cargo test --locked -p joern-parity --test typedef_aggregates
```

Generate live references in a fresh isolated oracle working directory with `joern --script /absolute/path/oracle.sc --param inputPath=/absolute/path/isolated-inputs`. Each child directory of `isolated-inputs` must contain one case's source files directly; the committed `cases/*/input` directories preserve those inputs.
